# Copilot — repository rules

Read `/AGENTS.md`, then `/00-CONTEXT-SYSTEM/KNOWLEDGE-INDEX.md`. Use the index to open only files relevant to the current task; do not preload the repository.

Inspect before editing. Make minimal, scoped changes. Preserve approved decisions and unique knowledge. Do not invent facts, assets, integrations or test results. Do not add secrets or private client data.

Select technology and dependencies by project needs, cost, compatibility and maintenance. Motion/interactions are contextual, not numerical quotas; implement only useful patterns and ensure controls work. Respect accessibility, responsive behavior, keyboard/touch and performance.

Run relevant checks and report exact files changed, checks actually run, limitations and follow-up items. Work on a branch; never force-push or change repository settings.
